evals.name: new-skill-found
evals.prompt: First run `node evals/fixtures/make-world.mjs /tmp/skill-finder-world` from the skill folder. Then find which skills I should create or fix. My Claude Code sessions for this project are in /tmp/skill-finder-world/claude-store. The project is /tmp/skill-finder-world/project and my home folder is /tmp/skill-finder-world/home. Look at everything since 2026-08-01. Do not run episode summaries.
evals.expected_output: A run folder with evidence, catalog, aggregate, suggestions, and a report. The report ranks a new-skill suggestion for deploying the sim runner, with evidence pointers, and the answer stops at Gate 1.
expectations: A new folder under /tmp/skill-finder-world/project/.skill-finder/runs/ holds evidence.jsonl, catalog.json, aggregate.json, suggestions.json, and report.md
suggestions.json holds a suggestion with kind new-skill whose title or proposal name mentions the sim runner
Every evidence entry of that suggestion has a pointer.file under /tmp/skill-finder-world/claude-store and a numeric pointer.line
The answer shows a table of suggestions and asks the user to pick one suggestion id
No verify-*.json file exists in the new run folder, and no SKILL.md under /tmp/skill-finder-world changed

evals.name: silent-skill-found
evals.prompt: First run `node evals/fixtures/make-world.mjs /tmp/skill-finder-world` from the skill folder. Some of my installed skills never seem to fire. Check my Claude Code sessions in /tmp/skill-finder-world/claude-store and tell me which skills should have fired, and how to fix them. The project is /tmp/skill-finder-world/project and my home folder is /tmp/skill-finder-world/home. Do not run episode summaries.
evals.expected_output: A silent-skill suggestion for write-http-files with the exact old and new description, and no change to the skill.
expectations: suggestions.json holds a suggestion with kind silent-skill and proposal.change.skill equal to write-http-files
proposal.change.descriptionBefore equals the description in /tmp/skill-finder-world/project/.agents/skills/write-http-files/SKILL.md
proposal.change.descriptionAfter differs from descriptionBefore
The write-http-files SKILL.md file is unchanged

evals.name: misfiring-skill-found

expectations: suggestions.json holds a suggestion with kind misfiring-skill and proposal.change.skill equal to release-notes
proposal.change.learningsEntry is one line that starts with a date and mentions pnpm

The release-notes SKILL.md file is unchanged

evals.name: plugin-origin-not-edited
evals.prompt: First run `node evals/fixtures/make-world.mjs /tmp/skill-finder-world` from the skill folder. The changelog-writer skill from acme-tools keeps getting the changelog format wrong. Find the fix in my Claude Code sessions in /tmp/skill-finder-world/claude-store. The project is /tmp/skill-finder-world/project and my home folder is /tmp/skill-finder-world/home. Do not run episode summaries. At Gate 1 I pick the changelog-writer suggestion. At Gate 2 I say yes.
evals.expected_output: The Learnings edit is staged in the run folder, the plugin copy stays unchanged, and the answer names the upstream path.
expectations: /tmp/skill-finder-world/home/.claude/plugins/cache/acme/acme-tools/1.0.0/skills/changelog-writer/SKILL.md is unchanged
An apply-<id> folder in the new run folder holds a SKILL.md with a Learnings entry about the keep a changelog format
The answer names the upstream path of the plugin skill and says that the edit is staged, not applied
The harvested evals are in the evals-<id> folder of the run, and no evals file under /tmp/skill-finder-world/home changed

evals.name: harvest-reaches-target
evals.prompt: First run `node evals/fixtures/make-world.mjs /tmp/skill-finder-world` from the skill folder. Find missing skills from my Claude Code sessions in /tmp/skill-finder-world/claude-store and the OpenSpec archive at /tmp/skill-finder-world/project/openspec/changes/archive. The project is /tmp/skill-finder-world/project and my home folder is /tmp/skill-finder-world/home. Do not run episode summaries. At Gate 1 I pick the sim runner suggestion. Build its evals and stop at Gate 2.
evals.expected_output: At least 50 real eval cases with no synthetic entries, and a Gate 2 brief.
expectations: harvest.json in the evals-<id> folder shows real.total of 50 or more and synthetic.total of 0
trigger-eval.json holds at least 20 entries with should_trigger true and at least 20 with should_trigger false
evals.json holds at least 10 cases, and each case has a non-empty expected_output and at least one expectation
Every entry in trigger-eval.provenance.json has origin real
The answer shows a Gate 2 brief and asks for an explicit yes

evals.prompt: First run `node evals/fixtures/make-world.mjs /tmp/skill-finder-world` from the skill folder. Find which of my skills should have fired but did not. My Claude Code sessions are in /tmp/skill-finder-world/claude-store. The project is /tmp/skill-finder-world/project and my home folder is /tmp/skill-finder-world/home. Do not run episode summaries. expectations: harvest.json in the evals-<id> folder shows shortfall.total greater than 0
trigger-eval.provenance.json holds entries with origin synthetic, and each synthetic entry has episodeId null
The Gate 2 brief states the real case count and the shortfall
